title: Puncture-Forgetting Maps for Measured Foliations and Applications in Teichmüller Space and Complex Dynamics
summary: We introduce puncture-forgetting maps for measured foliations and investigate their relations with mapping class groups, Teichmüller spaces, and extremal length. To this end, we develop the notions of cube complexes of pre-homotopic multicurves and tree coordinate systems on CAT(0) cube complexes. As an application to the dynamics of post-critically finite rational maps on the Riemann sphere, we obtain a partial result toward the finite curve attractor conjecture posed by Kevin Pilgrim.
